acceptance_cases.expected: Consume exact CI tar.zst/zip identified by run, attempt, artifact ID and SHA-256. Provenance schema 3 has expected Beam source SHA, native compiler revision, buildId and role mapping; all five listed artifacts match hashes, provenance is present verbatim, private inventory is exactly the six native files. Record full SDK configuration and archive digest; matching compiler Git hashes alone do not prove ABI/configuration identity. Compare extracted provenance SHA-256 with the producer-recorded digest rather than regenerating a new record after packaging.

Run the extracted SDK directly from a fresh path containing spaces and Unicode. Producer source/build/install paths are absent. No symlink/junction escapes into producer paths, developer caches or another SDK. POSIX executable permissions survive extraction; macOS canonical path aliases and Windows native/MSYS path conversion behave consistently.

Run CLI, MCP and daemon, load the LSP plugin through a real Lean session. Declared dependencies and live loaded modules resolve Beam and Lean/Lake code inside the extracted SDK. Only documented host-system libraries may resolve externally. Repeat with runtime environment overrides cleared and misleading standalone Beam paths.
evidence: readelf/ldd or otool or PE import output

acceptance_cases.expected: With no lean-toolchain file, the containing SDK works without elan invocation or provisioning. Start a session, sync/update a Lean file, run a successful proof probe, edit and resync it, reject a stale version, surface deliberate Lean diagnostics, then stop cleanly. An invalid probe must not poison the next valid one.

Use a dependency-free two-module Lake library plus executable, built only by the extracted SDK. Import a dependency and a metaprogram, save a changed module, verify Lake replays the saved output and both interpreted import and native executable observe the new value. Where deferred compilation is supported, save rejects that setup explicitly without changing existing artifact/trace bytes.
evidence: before/after artifact hashes for unsupported save

acceptance_cases.expected: Drive the extracted lean-beam-mcp with an independent stdio client: initialize, tools/list, lean_sync, proof/goal query, subsequent edit/sync and close/drop. Keep stdout protocol-only, test supported framing, and interleave two workspaces. Change one workspace selector to a foreign installation while the process is alive: admission fails without retargeting existing handles or corrupting the other valid workspace.

Use isolated ELAN_HOME and real elan toolchain links prepared before offline execution. Cover absent selector; matching SDK; a second alias/symlink/junction to the same SDK; existing foreign SDK (including another extraction with the same compiler revision); unavailable custom selector; floating selector without a local resolution; inherited ELAN_TOOLCHAIN conflict; malformed/dangling selector. Failures are distinct and never trigger download or silently fall back to bundled Lean.

On disposable copies, inventory validation rejects missing or modified executable/plugin/license before execution. Missing daemon/plugin or SDK shared libraries fail instead of loading a fallback. A live CLI/MCP session rejects replacement provenance/build generation; stop/drop/cleanup still works after admission fails or metadata is malformed. Do not require runtime to rehash arbitrary tampered files on every operation: immutable payload hash verification belongs to the acceptance gate.

Graceful stop/EOF/cancellation cleans owned processes and resources. Forced owner/client exit leaves no live owned worker; stale session files, if any, must be recognized and recovered safely on next start. Unrelated controlled sessions must remain healthy. Use external watchdogs and retained logs, including Windows job/process-group ownership.

Qualify Linux x86_64/aarch64, macOS x86_64/aarch64, and Windows x86_64 on native runners. On Windows include CRLF source, a normal PowerShell/native client environment without MSYS helping runtime discovery, and both tar.zst and zip when actually published. For formats of the same build compare extracted file hashes/inventory. Check supported Linux loader/GLIBC baseline and macOS architecture/relative loader paths against existing Lean release policy.

Report per-file and total uncompressed Beam sizes, full archive size and absence of duplicate Lean/Lake runtime copies. Payload-only compressed measurements must be labeled as standalone, not net distribution growth. Any strip/sign/loader-byte transformation must happen before the frozen Beam inventory is produced; later byte changes fail acceptance. Redownload final published assets and match their digests to the accepted archive set.
evidence: six-file final size/hash table per platform
